props.label: The chat agent at a glance

intro.title: What is an AI website chat agent?
intro.definition: is an assistant that lives on your website. It greets visitors, understands what they type, answers from your pages, documents and catalogue, walks them through guided steps — an enquiry, an estimate, a booking, an order, a return — and passes the conversation to a person whenever it should. Unlike a menu-only chatbot, it understands free text; unlike a generic AI, it sticks to your facts and your rules.

props.label: FAQ
props.title: Questions about the AI website chat agent

items.question: How do I try the live demo?
items.answer: Open demos.exyconn.com/website-chat-demo, sign in with your email and a one-time code, and chat with the agent as a visitor would. Try a service enquiry, ask for a project estimate, book a consultation or look for a product.

items.question: Do I need an OpenAI key?
items.answer: No. We run the AI for you as part of the service, so there is no key to create or bill to manage. If your company already has its own OpenAI or Azure OpenAI account and wants to use it, we can connect the agent to it instead.

items.question: Will it slow my site?
items.answer: No. The script loads asynchronously after your page has rendered, so your content, Core Web Vitals and SEO are not held up. The chat window only loads its full interface when a visitor opens it.

items.question: Can it hand over to a person?
items.answer: Yes. A visitor can ask for a person at any time, and you can set rules to hand over high-value leads or unhappy customers automatically. Your team picks up in live chat, email or WhatsApp with the full conversation, and outside office hours the agent takes the details and promises a reply.

items.question: Which languages does it speak?
items.answer: The agent understands and replies in the visitor's language, including English, Hindi, Spanish, French, German, Arabic and other major languages, and handles mixed language such as Hinglish. Your guided workflows can be translated so buttons and questions match too.

items.question: How is lead data stored?
items.answer: Leads and transcripts are stored in your own account, encrypted in transit and at rest, and access is limited to your team. They are sent on to your CRM or inbox as you choose, retention follows your rules, and the agent can show your privacy notice and ask for consent before it collects details.

items.question: Which websites does it work on?
items.answer: Any website that can take a script tag: WordPress, WooCommerce, Shopify, Webflow, Wix, Squarespace, React, Next.js, Vue and plain HTML. We install it for you or send your developer a single line to paste.

items.question: Will it make things up?
items.answer: The agent answers from your own website, documents and catalogue, and the guided workflows follow fixed steps for prices, bookings, orders and returns. When it does not know, it says so and offers a person instead of guessing.

items.question: Can it connect to our CRM, calendar and helpdesk?
items.answer: Yes. We connect it to tools such as HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho, Google Calendar, Outlook, Calendly, Zendesk, Freshdesk, Shopify and WooCommerce, and to your own systems over their APIs.

items.question: How long does it take to launch?
items.answer: A focused agent with your content and two or three workflows typically goes live in two to three weeks, including integrations, testing on a staging copy of your site and your team's sign-off.
